Manage command resources

Usage:
  inframill command [flags]
  inframill command [command]

Available Commands:
  execution   Manage execution resources
  list        ListCommandDefinitions through the daemon
  show        ListCommandDefinitions through the daemon

Flags:
      --config string     optional CLI defaults YAML; explicit files are required (default ".inframill.yaml")
      --endpoint string   daemon HTTP(S) base URL (default "http://127.0.0.1:8080")
  -h, --help              help for command
  -o, --output string     output format: table or json (logs: json only) (default "table")
      --timeout string    total invocation deadline (default "2m")

Global Flags:
      --color string   human output color: auto, always or never (default "auto")

Use "inframill command [command] --help" for more information about a command.
